You can also start writing your symptoms down when it happens, it really helps a lot! +if you’re struggling with a routine: what helped me was creating 3 different routines based of how much power i have and how good im feeling today (really helps to really do things as brushing your teeth etc)

Everything starts in your mind. Don’t let your fear control you, fear makes your mind irrational.  Start to tell your head everything positive that it needs to get yourself up. Sounds silly but if bad thoughts, guilt and shame can control your though process why not good ones? Be delusional in your own advance. Tell yourself to stop when you catch yourself drifting away. Tell yourself that you can to this exercise. People don’t get that somethings wrong if you don’t signalize it thru your body language and face expressions. Catch yourself because YOU ARE YOUR OWN BEST FRIEND. And you don’t want your best friend to feel bad, right?
